consumers.name: apps/api/tools/architecture-validator
consumers.decision: Reject cfg_attr conditional hiding locally; apply API-ARCH-008 to structural capability prefixes inside official async-graphql resolver impl attributes and ordinary canonical adapter-graphql use leaves, rather than file, path-word, method-name, or import-resolution inference; retain only direct raw-SQL AST checks.

consumers.name: apps/api/Cargo.toml and .github/workflows/test-api.yml

consumers.name: apps/api/architecture/exceptions.toml and docs/adr
consumers.decision: Preserve Unix SIGTERM and non-Unix shutdown behavior through two exact 30-day cfg exceptions rather than a broad conditional-compilation allow.

consumers.name: apps/api/tools/xtask
consumers.decision: Expose deterministic image-catalog generate and verify commands.

consumers.name: generated runtime and catalog
consumers.decision: Verify checked-in generated output against the single fixed template.

consumers.name: tracked scratch
consumers.decision: No .superpowers scratch is tracked.

consumers.name: PR evidence
consumers.decision: Require one structured marker that binds task identities, test states, Sol result, and final head SHA.

rejectedSimplerAlternatives: Ignoring deleted or rename/copy source diff paths
Resolver file catalogs, vocabulary inference, method tables, or import resolution
Custom unwrap or expect method-name AST

tasks.rollback: Revert Terra implementation milestones as a coherent set.

tasks.responsibility: Independently review the frozen Terra head only; own no files and do not create a post-review manifest commit.
acceptance: Independent Sol result is recorded in PR body or CI evidence against the exact frozen head SHA.

consumers.name: pull request body
consumers.decision: Store exact SHA approval externally so prose-only edits rerun validation without invalidating a matching approval.

rejectedSimplerAlternatives: Trusting a review without SHA binding

tasks.rollback: A changed head creates a new freeze and independent review; never mutate the frozen manifest after review.
